column1: # PROVENANCE for everything in theme/canonical/. Data, not prose, because
# docrender/vectors.py READS this file on every build and compares blob_sha
# against the bytes actually on disk.
# WHY THE VENDORED FILES CARRY NO HEADER COMMENTS
# Every other TSV in this engine opens with a comment block. These do not, and
# that is deliberate: a comment would change their bytes and destroy the one
# thing that proves they ARE the canonical tables. Their identity is their hash.
# WHAT THE CHECK PROVES, AND WHAT IT DOES NOT
# PROVES: the file on disk is byte-for-byte what we vendored. Catches a hand
# edit, a partial write, an editor that stripped a trailing newline or converted
# tabs -- the failure modes that turn a design system into a lookalike.
# DOES NOT PROVE: that what we vendored is still current upstream. That needs a
# scheduled job with network access, and it does not exist yet. WARNING: stated
# rather than implied, because a green check that answers a narrower question
# than the reader assumes is worse than no check.
# HOW TO REFRESH: replace the file wholesale from the source repo, put the new
# blob SHA here, and re-run the build. Never edit a vendored file in place.
# REFRESH LOG. Newest first.
# 2026-08-05  THE EOS HARNESS RETIRES. colors c576bcf -> 4691aee, themes.json
#             e6b7c7e -> 7711cab. Michael: "i think i've proved my point with
#             the eos wild themes... revert the one color row to a more stable
#             'eos' blind mode blue and yellow and blue and purple." 22 of 24
#             cells on the eos DARK row, re-authored from a photograph of an
#             Element2 console sitting in BLIND; every chrome cell now lands
#             within THREE degrees of hue 217 where the harness spanned 224.
#             themes.json carries prose only -- the eos join's harness warning
#             was now false and the semantic grammar is stated instead.
#             WARNING colors.tsv is 7,719 B BEFORE AND AFTER. Third occurrence
#             in this file of identical size with different content.
# 2026-08-05  THE COLOUR TABLE BECOMES CLUELESS. colors 75b3f6c -> c576bcf
#             (38 cols -> 24, 23 rows -> 39), themes.json 09e429b -> e6b7c7e
#             (schemaVersion 4, +alt-color on every join).
#             Michael: "the color tab needs to be totally clueless as to its
#             joins to any other state... any joining must happen externally in
#             a join table." CULLED identity, name and the 12-column alt- band;
#             every alt band TRANSPOSED into its own complete row (williams-dark,
#             ferrari-light, papyrus-dark...) losslessly, since the 7 tokens the
#             band never carried were SHARED and already painted into both
#             schemes. RED the engine cannot read this table without the matching
#             vectors.py commit -- derivation reads a column that no longer
#             exists. RED and the first write was REFUSED on a stale SHA:
#             Michael had hand-committed an eos identification harness minutes
#             earlier (9374be2) and the generated table would have wiped it.
# 2026-08-05  667e4a9 -> 75b3f6c  OUTLANDISH ACCENTS, 30 cells across the six
#             split rows. Deliberate PROOF VALUES: Material's fallback blue
#             survived for weeks because it read as "docs site" rather than as
#             broken. All measured against canvas AND card AND their own
#             on-accent; two candidates rejected on measurement (4.44, 4.36).
#             SAME 6,674 BYTES as the previous vendor.
# 2026-08-05  e14e3a6 -> 667e4a9  THE SPLIT. J10/S1 implemented for three
#             identities. RED this broke `light: eos` in site.yml SILENTLY.
# 2026-08-05  eade05c -> e14e3a6  eos light: placeholder green retired, magenta
#             deepened for the light ground (3.46:1 -> 5.06:1).
# 2026-08-05  27b5327 -> eade05c  eos dark RE-AUTHORED; amber moves to `accent`,
#             on-accent inverts to near-black, clearing eos from D7.
# 2026-08-05  4f391aa -> 27b5327  ONE CELL, a proof value. STILL 5,710 BYTES --
#             the argument for hashing over measuring.
# 2026-08-04  --      -> 4f391aa  Initial vendor. 19 themes x 36 columns.
